premises.text: Warehouse inventory tracking today is highly manual, slow, and inaccurate, so items get lost
premises.evidence_span: keeping track of inventory. Today, that is a highly manual and incredibly slow process. And beyond that, it doesn't even ensure accuracy

premises.text: Flying robots with computer vision and robotics automate indoor inventory data capture at centimeter accuracy without GPS
premises.evidence_span: Our flying robots are able to fly autonomously indoors with centimeter accuracy without any external systems

premises.text: The offering is a fleet of flying robots, on-site infrastructure, and real-time analytics software for high-bay selective-rack warehouses
premises.evidence_span: Our product consists of three things, a fleet of these flying robots, on-site infrastructure to relay the information we collect to the workers, and real-time analytics software

premises.text: Hardware is sold upfront like industrial automation equipment, with software on subscription and data-driven premiums
premises.evidence_span: We are selling the hardware, just like traditional industrial automation equipment, into the warehouses for an upfront setup fee that takes care of the hardware and installation. At the same time, we're selling the software on a subscription basis, where as our system collects more information, we can add data-driven premiums

value.text: Make inventory errors a thing of the past and improve warehouse operational efficiency
value.evidence_span: make inventory errors a thing of the past

secondary_value.text: Cost savings by reducing the need to hold extra buffer inventory
secondary_value.evidence_span: generating about $4 million in cost savings because these companies don't have to hold extra inventory anymore
